summary: Phase 2 testing complete. Backend pytest: 37/38 (97.4%) - new TestReviews (4 tests) and TestRecommendations (3 tests) all PASS. AI recommendations endpoint returns valid product list (0-4 items) + reasoning string, falls back to algorithm when LLM fails. Reviews endpoint correctly recalcs product.rating/reviews_count. Frontend: AI Tavsiyalari section, Mijozlar sharhlari section, live review submission, non-logged login-CTA, enhanced 5-method payment UI with VISA card visual preview that updates live, 16-digit card-number auto-format, MM/YY expiry auto-format, masked CVV (type=password, 3 max), 4-step order tracking timeline on dashboard - ALL working correctly. Checkout 3-step flow no longer bounces to /cart (iter1 bug fixed).

minor.issue: test_cart_flow returns empty body intermittently when run in parallel with TestOrders on different xdist workers sharing the same user user@test.uz cart (known flaky from iter1, not a production bug)

issues: data-testid for Bank kartasi option is 'payment-card' (id='card'), while review spec referenced 'payment-bank_card'. Implementation is consistent, but spec/code mismatch could confuse future automation. Suggest renaming id to 'bank_card' OR update spec.

action_items: Optional: rename payment method id 'card' → 'bank_card' in /app/frontend/src/pages/Checkout.js (line 264) to match spec, then existing data-testid='payment-bank_card' would work as documented.

Optional: After successful order placement at /checkout, page does not navigate to a /thank-you route — order-success screen does render via state, but URL stays /checkout. Consider router.push to a dedicated route for back-button safety.
critical_code_review_comments: AI recommendations endpoint at server.py L779 imports emergentintegrations inside the route handler — should be moved to top-level for faster cold start.
Review rating is not validated (1-5 bounds) on backend — currently /api/reviews accepts rating=999 or negative; add Pydantic Field(ge=1, le=5).
No protection against same user posting multiple reviews on the same product — could spam ratings.
server.py still 911 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline (carryover from iter1).
AI recommendations call has no timeout — a slow LLM could block request indefinitely; consider asyncio.wait_for.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (added TestReviews extended + TestRecommendations classes, fixed admin status param name new_status)
seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Test runs created some TEST_ reviews and a couple of orders for user@test.uz dashboard.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend has 38 pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py with -n 2 --dist loadscope from pytest.ini. The only flaky failure (test_cart_flow) is shared-state with TestOrders across workers — not a real bug. AI recommendations endpoint takes 5-15s due to LLM call, fallback works fine. Frontend Phase 2 components verified: ProductDetail (reviews+AI), ReviewForm (5 stars+comment), Checkout enhanced payment UI with live card visual, OrderTracking (4 steps + cancelled red state). Checkout 3-step flow works end-to-end.
rca_of_the_issue: No new bugs found. Iter1 Checkout.js redirect bug appears resolved — /checkout now loads with steps when cart has items. Only minor naming inconsistency: payment method id 'card' vs spec 'bank_card'.
